lines.en: Half black, half white, swimming together.

lines.zh: 暖水珊瑚间，我们兜圈子。
lines.en: We circle among the warm coral.
A lone one goes looking for a school.

lines.zh: 我们的花纹是一整个圆。
lines.en: Our pattern forms a single circle.

lines.zh: 太极在水里转，黑白互相追。
lines.en: The taiji turns; black chases white.

lines.zh: 群游时像一片翻动的纸。
lines.en: Schooling, we look like turning paper.
Only two points of health; we swim carefully.

lines.zh: 珊瑚枝间钻过去，鳍不碰。
lines.en: Threading coral branches without touching.
The smallest fish swims in the middle.
The warm current pushes us along.
Not so fast; the school will scatter.

lines.zh: 黑白相间，远看只有一团。
lines.en: Black and white blur into one shape.
We round the reef edge once.

lines.zh: 附近鱼群的味道，我认得。
lines.en: I know the smell of nearby schools.
I follow the white spot ahead.

lines.zh: 水一动，我们就一起转向
lines.en: The water shifts and we all turn together.
Hovering over coral in the sunlight.
Black half and white half think separately.
I hold position with my tail.
Warm water makes my scales shine.
A school passes; I join it.
The taiji pattern turns slowly.
Two points of health; I keep still.
Checking coral cracks for tiny bugs.
Alone like this, I feel empty.
White sand below mirrors my pattern.
Don't disturb me; I'm counting schools.

lines.zh: 太阳斜了，太极在鳞上转。
lines.en: The sun slants; taiji turns on my scales.
Being the odd one out isn't nice.

lines.zh: 两条一组的队形最好看。
lines.en: Pairs make the prettiest formation.
You've stood on that reef a while.
From here you look like a pillar.
Your shadow covers the coral.
Want to watch us turn in a circle?
Only two points of health; we're fragile.

lines.zh: 你手里那个桶，我们认得。
lines.en: We recognize that bucket in your hand.

lines.zh: 别踩珊瑚，那里有我们的卵。
lines.en: Mind the coral; our eggs are there.
Are you waiting for us to come closer?

lines.zh: 太阳照在你背上，是暖的。
lines.en: Sunlight on your back looks warm.

lines.zh: 一群鱼里，你只看得见花纹。
lines.en: In a school, you only see patterns.
Two points of health; half gone at once.

lines.zh: 花纹被撞花了，黑白难辨。
lines.en: My pattern's smeared; black and white blurred.
It hurts; into the coral, quickly.
We're too small to take a hit.
The school panicked and scattered.

lines.zh: 我的黑半身蹭掉了一角。
lines.en: A corner of my black half scraped away.
You straggler, come back here.
A corner of my fin is gone.

lines.zh: 别追了，我们只剩一口气。
lines.en: Stop chasing; we're barely alive.
Even warm water can't ease this.
Fish food? A pinch is enough.
We're small; we don't eat much.
Both halves smell it now.

lines.zh: 撒多了，整群会挤成一团。
lines.en: Too much and the school clumps together.
Scatter it and the whole school comes.
We can't outcompete the big fish.
Whatever lands on the coral is mine.
Smells like shrimp; not sure.
Closer, just a tiny bit closer.
Eat and disperse; don't linger.
One bump and my pattern's crooked.
Only two points; be gentle.
The swell pushed you into me.
The school broke; regroup fast.
Your knee hit the coral.
I spun; black and white swapped.
Don't crowd; the taiji gets muddled.
That bump sent me into the branches.
Small fish can't take a shove.
Clear the lane; we're schooling through.
Two of us swimming one circle.
Black and white join into one picture.
We circle behind the coral.

lines.zh: 卵会粘在暖水的石头上。
lines.en: Eggs stick to warm stones.
Not too close; we're pairing up.
Two points of health, and still we spawn.

lines.zh: 伴侣的花纹跟我正相反。
lines.en: My partner's pattern is exactly opposite.

lines.zh: 黑白绕三圈，卵就落下了。
lines.en: Three turns of black and white; eggs fall.
The fry will find their own school.
The warm season is short; hurry.

lines.zh: 桶里没有珊瑚，也没太阳。
lines.en: No coral, no sunlight in the bucket.

lines.zh: 我们这么小，一桶能装一群。
lines.en: We're small; a bucket holds a school.
One shake and my pattern blurs.
Two points of health; no rough handling.

lines.zh: 你要带我去别处的暖水吗。
lines.en: Taking me to warmer water elsewhere?
Alone in here, I'll look for a school.
Smooth walls; I can't circle.

lines.zh: 别把我和大鱼放在一起。
lines.en: Don't put me with the big fish.
Less water; my gills feel tight.

lines.zh: 放我回珊瑚，那里才有阴阳。
lines.en: Back to the coral, where yin and yang live.
Something big is swimming over.
The whole school shrinks into the coral.
Two points of health; hide first.
That's not a fish; that's a boot.
A shadow covers the reef flat.

lines.zh: 大家靠拢，黑白连成一片。
lines.en: Gather close; our patterns merge.

lines.zh: 我们的花纹在阳光下太显眼。
lines.en: Our pattern stands out in sunlight.
Sink a little deeper and watch.
Stay calm; schooling confuses hunters.
That big fish is circling us.

lines.zh: 我们盯着你，也盯着出口。
lines.en: We watch you, and the exit.
Two points of health, but sharp eyes.

lines.zh: 黑白相间，你分不清前后。
lines.en: Black and white; you can't tell front.
Don't reach; we'll scatter.
The coral branches are our walls.
You move slowly underwater.

lines.zh: 整群同时转向，看着吓人。
lines.en: The school turns at once; it's alarming.

lines.zh: 我们只是小鱼，别逼我们。
lines.en: We're only small fish; don't push us.

lines.zh: 数一数，你只看得见两种花纹。
lines.en: Count; you'll only see two patterns.
When you leave, we'll disperse.

lines.zh: 我们咬你脚踝上的绒毛。
lines.en: We nip the fuzz on your ankle.
Two points of health, still charging.
The whole school pecks like needles.
Black and white spin before your eyes.
One hit, then back into the coral.

lines.zh: 我们打不疼，但会让你烦。
lines.en: We can't hurt you, but we annoy.
Grab a fin ray and pull.
You broke coral; now pay.
The school mobs one big fish.
Split up; come from four directions.
A black-and-white pair in warm water.

lines.zh: 太极花纹在珊瑚间散开。
lines.en: Taiji patterns spread among the coral.
We school from the moment we're born.
Two points of health, a tiny body.
A new school circles the reef.
Sun's right; the water's warm.

lines.zh: 落单那条已经在找队伍。
lines.en: The lone one already seeks a school.

lines.zh: 珊瑚缝就是我们的产房。
lines.en: Coral cracks are our nursery.

lines.zh: 又一幅阴阳图游了出来。
lines.en: Another yin-yang picture swims out.

lines.zh: 这片暖海从来不缺我们。
lines.en: This warm sea never lacks us.
Can the seawater catch fire too?

lines.zh: 从水面掉下去，转了好几圈。
lines.en: Dropped from the surface, spinning over and over.

lines.zh: 在水里呛到，还是第一次。
lines.en: Choking on water; that's a first.
The blast ground coral into white sand.
Something stabbed down from above.
A purple glow rises over my pattern.
So hungry my pattern has dimmed.

lines.zh: 海面白了一下，整群下沉。
lines.en: The sea flashed white; the school sank.
Even warm water and sunlight are gone.
